steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Traditional British dishes include: roast beef and Yorkshire pudding, fish and chips, shepherd's pie, full English breakfast, Sunday roast, and trifle. | Key Fact: British cuisine has been significantly influenced by immigration and global trade: Indian, Chinese, Italian, Caribbean, and Middle Eastern foods are now part of everyday British eating. | Key Fact: Chicken tikka masala is often described as a British national dish, reflecting the fusion of Indian cooking with British tastes. | Key Fact: Key international cuisines and their staples: Italian (pasta, olive oil, tomatoes), Indian (rice, spices, lentils, ghee), Chinese (rice, soy sauce, stir-frying), Mexican (tortillas, beans, chillies), Thai (rice, coconut, lemongrass).

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from british & international cuisine, and one past-paper question.
